page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-96-lssd is a high-memory, storage-equipped server instance belonging to the c4n family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 744.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory allocation of 7.75 GB per core. For local storage, the instance includes 16 local NVMe SSDs providing a total capacity of 6442 GB. This configuration does not include any graphics processing units and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The combination of a high vCPU count, substantial memory capacity, and large local NVMe SSD storage makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the integration of 16 local SSDs directly into the instance profile reduces the need for external block storage attachments, optimizing resource density for data-intensive applications. This server is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, memory-intensive data processing, enterprise applications, and high-throughput local storage operations.
